description: Natural log of night-time radiance per person, ln(10⁸ × NTL / population). description: Hodrick–Prescott trend (λ = 400) of the log of night-time lights per capita. Complete for every municipality and year, including years where ln_NTLpc is missing.

description: SDG 1 (No poverty) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Components: Multidimensional poverty index (0-1); Energy poverty (% of dwellings); Unsatisfied basic needs (% of population); Access to the 3 basic services (% of households). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS1”.
source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

description: Multidimensional poverty index MPI = A × H, where H is the share of households (in private dwellings) deprived in 3 or more of 9 indicators and A the average intensity (share of the 9 deprivations) among them. Multidimensional poverty follows Andersen & Branisa (2020): nine deprivations in three dimensions (resources: drinking water, electricity, sanitation; power and voice: an illiterate member aged 15+, a member aged 6+ without an identity card, no fixed or mobile phone; opportunities and choice: a birth in the last five years not attended by skilled personnel, a teenage pregnancy in the last five years, a member aged 6-19 not attending school). Source: own calculation of the Atlas from the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 1 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0.563 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 0.066 and major challenges from 0.23 on. Atlas indicator 01_02_02_01_mpi, “Índice de pobreza multidimensional” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

description: Percentage of dwellings whose annual residential electricity consumption is below the regional energy-poverty threshold: 252 kWh/year in the west (Chuquisaca, La Paz, Cochabamba, Oruro, Potosí, Tarija) and 516 kWh/year in the east (Santa Cruz, Beni, Pando); dwellings without a meter and meters with zero consumption also count as energy poor. Initial value 2016 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 1 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 100 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 15 and major challenges from 50 on. description: SDG 16 (Peace, justice and strong institutions) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 4 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Homicide rate (per 100,000 people); Budget execution (%); Social conflicts (events per year); Children under 5 in the civil registry (%). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS16”.
source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

description: Average annual number of reported crimes against life (homicides, murders, infanticides, femicides and parricides) per 100,000 inhabitants over three years. Source: Bolivian Observatory of Citizen Security and the Fight against Drugs (OBSCD). Initial value average 2017–2019 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 16 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 9 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 1.5 and major challenges from 4 on. Atlas indicator 16_01_01_01_thp, “Tasa de homicidios registrados (por 100,000 habitantes)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

description: Percentage of the municipality's programmed budget that is executed, averaged over three years. Source: the Ministry of Economy and Public Finance (MEFP). Atlas indicator 16_06_01_02_cep, “Capacidad de ejecución del presupuesto programado (%)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
